title: Find the Largest Palindrome Divisible by K
summary: Return the largest n-digit palindrome with no leading zero that is divisible by k, as a string. Return an empty string if none exists.
officialConstraints: 1 <= n <= 10^5 and 1 <= k <= 9 (search summary citing leetcode.com).
examples: n = 3, k = 5 -> "595"; n = 5, k = 6 -> "89898" (search summary citing leetcode.com).
visualizationNotes: Playback accepts n up to 40. Greedy outside-in digit choice with suffix reach sets; checked by brute force for n up to 12.
